ABOUT THE COMPANY
Mayfly Ventures Pty Ltd is a venture studio founded in 2022 and based in Melbourne, Victoria, specialising in building vertical SaaS and AI ventures. The team comprises engineers, designers, and venture builders who partner with industry experts to design, build, and launch disruptive technology products. Mayfly's core capabilities span venture building, solution design (UX/UI design, UX research, business process mapping, and product strategy), and full product development including MVP delivery, AI agent development, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms.

The studio works with both established businesses and growth-stage startups, specialising in rapidprototyping and iterative product development to help clients achieve product-market fit and reduce the technical barriers between idea and execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.
You will work closely with founders, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality, scalable software solutions, leveraging modern no-code platforms, AI tooling, and best-practice software development methods.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead end-to-end design and development of web and mobile applications, managing priorities, timelines, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Analyse user requirements and translate them into software specifications, user flows, information architecture, and technical design decisions
• Architect scalable, performant application structures including database design, backend workflow logic, and API integration strategies
• Design and develop responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces applying UI/UX design principles to maximise usability, engagement, and product quality
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and external services to extend
application functionality

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Candidates must demonstrate the following:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as a Developer Programmer, Software Developer, or equivalent, with a strong portfolio of delivered software projects
• Proficiency in no-code application development, particularly Bubble.io, with demonstrated ability to build complex, production-grade web and mobile applications
• Solid understanding of database design, data modelling, relational structures, and backend workflow logic
• Demonstrated experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services into production application environments
• Strong UI/UX design capability including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity interface design using tools such as Figma
• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for front-end customisation and interface optimisation
• Experience applying Agile methodologies and using project management tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or Trello
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and system-level thinking
• Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities, with capacity to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced delivery environment

DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES
• Experience designing and deploying AI-integrated product features and agentic or automated decision workflows
• Familiarity with additional platforms and tools such as Cursor, Bubble, Xano, and AI
• Experience with payment infrastructure integration (e.g. Stripe Connect) and end-to-end monetisation flow design
• Experience leading small development or design teams across concurrent client-facing delivery engagements
• Experience working across multiple industries including fintech, health, education, logistics, or hospitality technology sectors

HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates should submit a current resume, a cover letter addressing the key
selection criteria, and examples of relevant projects or a portfolio link to careers@mayflyventures.com

The Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer who will single-handedly analyse, design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack operational systems serving Chinese clients across semiconductor, MCU, and cross-border business domains. This is not a narrowly scoped position — the successful candidate must independently manage the complete lifecycle of multiple concurrent software systems, from requirements gathering with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders through to production deployment on China-compliant infrastructure.

The role requires a rare combination of full-stack software engineering, hands-on Linux server administration, working familiarity with IC design and EDA tool environments, and the ability to operate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese across technical, business, and compliance contexts. The candidate will be the primary technical owner of all systems and must be capable of working without supervision across all layers of the stack and across all stages of delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack web applications end-to-end — including React or Vue front-end interfaces, Python-based backend services, relational databases, RESTful APIs, authentication systems, and administrative dashboards — within a single-engineer ownership model.
- Build and maintain internal tools, management systems, workflow dashboards, and client-facing operational platforms for cross-border Chinese SMEs, semiconductor companies, and engineering teams, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms (WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-specific cloud APIs) using Chinese-language API documentation.
- Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and workflow automation systems that support IC design operations, including DFT workflows, Verilog-based digital logic design, verification pipelines, and EDA tool environments (Cadence and Synopsys) — covering environment configuration, licence server management, and build-flow automation.
- Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain applications on Linux-based server environments across Mainland China and international infrastructure, including ICP-filed domains, China-based hosting, cross-border DNS and CDN configuration, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and environment-specific application configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues specific to China-facing deployments, including Great Firewall constraints and dual-environment architectures.
- Identify technology limitations, performance bottlenecks, and process gaps across existing systems, then independently design, implement, and document improvements — maintaining technical documentation, API references, deployment runbooks, and operational procedures in both English and Chinese.
- Analyse operational metrics, system performance data, user feedback, and error reports to drive continuous improvement across all systems under management.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for bilingual teams, Chinese clients, and stakeholders across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia, conducting requirements gathering and technical communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Technical Requirements

Required

- Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complete systems from front-end to backend to deployment.
- Strong proficiency in Python as a primary backend language, with production experience in Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building database-backed web applications and API services.
- Production experience developing front-end interfaces using React or Vue (not merely prototyping), including state management, component architecture, API integration, and responsive design.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining internal tools, admin panels, operational dashboards, and workflow management platforms for business users.
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design, relational database modelling (PostgreSQL or MySQL), authentication and authorisation systems, third-party API integration, and system-to-system communication patterns.
- Hands-on Linux server administration experience, including setup, configuration, application deployment, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS management, firewall rules, log management, cron jobs, process supervision, and production troubleshooting — not merely development on Linux.
- Practical experience with Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and cloud or hybrid server deployment environments.
- Working knowledge of digital IC design workflows, including an understanding of DFT (Design for Test) concepts, Verilog HDL, digital logic design, synthesis, and verification processes — sufficient to develop, configure, and maintain software tools and workflow integrations that support IC design engineering teams.
- Direct experience working with EDA tool environments, specifically Cadence and/or Synopsys toolchains, including at least one of: tool installation and environment configuration, licence server setup and management, build-flow scripting and automation, or integration of EDA tools into broader engineering workflow platforms.
- Familiarity with ARM Cortex and/or RISC-V processor architectures and MCU-based development workflows, with sufficient understanding to build and maintain software systems that support semiconductor engineering and production operations.
- Demonstrated experience with Mainland China infrastructure and compliance requirements, including ICP filing processes, China-based hosting configuration, China-accessible domain and DNS setup, and deployment of applications that function reliably behind the Great Firewall.
- Experience building operational software systems for Chinese businesses, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms, services, or APIs (e.g., WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-based cloud providers), with the ability to independently read and implement from Chinese-language technical documentation.

Preferred

- Experience developing automation scripts, engineering workflow tools, internal development platforms, or integration layers specifically for semiconductor or IC design teams in China.
- Understanding of MCU, semiconductor, embedded systems, or IC design industries in Greater China and broader Asia, particularly where software platforms support engineering, production, or client delivery workflows.
- Experience with software performance optimisation, security hardening, monitoring and alerting systems, and deployment automation for production environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
- Familiarity with cross-border data handling, dual-environment deployment architectures (China/international), and the operational constraints of running software services that must function in both mainland Chinese and international network environments simultaneously.
- Experience working in small teams or as a sole technical operator with full ownership of systems from requirements through to production support.

Language & Communication

- Proficient in English.
- Fluent Mandarin Chinese, both spoken and written, is required.
- Ability to communicate technical requirements, system issues, software specifications, and deployment matters with Chinese clients and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
- Ability to read and interpret Chinese platform documentation, API documentation, compliance materials, and technical communication; draft technical communications in Chinese for mainland stakeholders; and navigate Chinese-language developer resources, forums, and support channels without assistance.

Colormaker Industries Australia is a well-established, family-owned manufacturer of quality coatings for interior and exterior application. Amongst a broad range of technologies, Colormaker also manufactures and exports market leading world class products in textile screen printing inks and high solids epoxy swimming pool coatings. The business is based on Sydney’s Northern Beaches.

We require a dedicated coatings & inks Quality Control (QC) Chemist to join our busy team of specialists in Brookvale, NSW.

Reporting to the Senior Chemist and Technical Manager, the duties and responsibilities of the role will include:

. Performing laboratory tests/QC procedures on paints and raw materials and recommending improvements for Factory Production and Product Development
. Preparing materials for test and/or experimentation
. Performing calculations, computations and measurements
. Analyzing test data results and preparing relevant reviews, reports and summaries
. Auditing and controlling the quality and quantity of materials used in QC tests, R&D and product maintenance
. Checking, calibrating and maintaining test equipment and other laboratory facilities
. Management of Safety Data Sheets, both Raw Materials and Finished Goods
. Technical and other support to Customer Service and Marketing, including translation of technical and other product literature
. Proficient use of Tencia/Arrow, Color I Control and relevant business software (including MS EXCEL). Also use of company systems
. Maintenance of relevant QC and Production records and related administration
. Adhering to appropriate workplace health and safety standards and making recommendations for improvement
. Management of Hazardous Materials and Dangerous Goods.
. Advising and sourcing materials for Research and Development (R&D) projects
. Carrying out product development work on new and existing products

We offer a competitive remuneration package of between $70,000 to $85,000 per annum, excluding superannuation.

The successful candidate will have either:

. A relevant AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus five (5) years’ work experience; or
. At least ten (10) years of relevant full-time work experience

The successful candidate must have coatings experience. In particular, high solids epoxy, high performance industrial surface coatings, broad wall architectural and construction membranes etc would be highly regarded, as would knowledge of textile and other screen printing ink technologies. They must also be passionate about the environment, have a good eye for colour and for detail as well as an ability to work with minimal supervision. A high degree of numeracy and literacy in English are mandatory, whilst technical fluency in European languages would be highly regarded.  Applicants must have full and permanent working rights in Australia to be considered.

If you feel that you are suited to the role of Quality Control Chemist, then please send your CV to us via email technical@colormaker.com.au.

## Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Structural Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design, analysis, and delivery of a diverse range of construction and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise, a commitment to structural integrity, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. This role suits an experienced engineer who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about delivering safe, innovative, and cost-effective structural solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

- Analyse structural systems for both static and dynamic loading conditions, ensuring all designs meet relevant Australian standards and codes of practice
- Determine appropriate construction methods, materials, and quality standards, and develop detailed specifications, drawings, and construction procedures to guide project delivery
- Design structures across a range of typologies to ensure they perform safely and do not collapse, deflect excessively, or behave in any undesirable manner under load
- Prepare and review engineering drawings, reports, and documentation in support of development approvals, construction certificates, and project handover
- Conduct site inspections and supervise construction activities to verify works are being carried out in accordance with approved designs and specifications
- Assess and evaluate the behaviour and durability of construction materials, recommending suitable options based on project requirements and site conditions
